take: Nashville announced it acquired defenseman Jayden Struble from Montreal for a second-round pick (listed as 20227 in the text), while Montreal announced it received that pick. Struble has played six games for the Predators without a point, and Nashville controlled 40.5 percent of the expected goals at 5-on-5 when he was on the ice. The team was 2.5 percentage points better with him off it. The Canadiens drop a defenseman who played 59 games last season (2 goals, 12 points) and gain the pick.
